answer: Each epoch, the network releases a small oasis of real work — a few quartz tasks that must actually be done, each one verifiable and each solvable only once. An identity earns its place by solving one task and locking the proof in its own vault, bound to its key. A farm of a thousand fakes needs a thousand tasks, but the oasis holds only a few, so most fakes go thirsty; each fake must do real, unique work that cannot be copied, shared, or bought, and the vault only opens for the identity that did it.
